status: PROPOSAL, NOT ADOPTED. The S6 gate (v1) and its thresholds stay in force until the owner approves a separately versioned adoption.

proposed_changes.replaces: A7 effective episodes (Kish factor on declared cluster size and rho)
proposed_changes.new: overlap- and regime-aware effective sample: effective independent observations = raw episodes / DEFF where DEFF = 1 + (m-1)*rho_x + overlap term from the declared mean holding period D (D/step - 1)*rho_t, plus a minimum number of independent regime episodes (>= 4 bull/bear alternations or a documented waiver)
proposed_changes.rationale: q2/q3: the v1 factor understates the design effect by up to 6.7x at 20-day holds and more under regime means
proposed_changes.calibration: stored q2/q3 grid; adoption requires |DEFF_formula - DEFF_true| <= 25 % on the grid

proposed_changes.replaces: A7 MDE criterion applied to every family
proposed_changes.new: claim-type-specific power: (a) absolute return claim keeps v1 MDE; (b) relative/defensive claim declares a benchmark and uses paired information-ratio or timing-null power with a declared skill range; both require declared plausible effect size >= MDE at 80 % power
proposed_changes.rationale: q1/q5: v1 favours exposure; timing null has equal power at 20 % and 90 % invested
proposed_changes.calibration: size in [0.03, 0.08] under the null and power >= 0.8 at the declared effect on the stored simulation

proposed_changes.new: declared invested share must come from a stored simulation of the frozen risk layer (V3 when adopted) at the family's declared portfolio volatility, using the simulated p10-p90 band
proposed_changes.rationale: q6/q6b: the declared 0.9-1.0 is unrealistic for crypto-like volatility
proposed_changes.calibration: a spec declaring 0.9-1.0 at 54 % volatility must fail; the B2 draft must fail at the simulated shares

proposed_changes.new: report-only non-normality inflation of the MDE (Mertens) and an HAC-based n_eff
proposed_changes.rationale: q4: small effect at daily frequency

proposed_changes.new: ex-post comparators (volatility-matched, cash-mix, exposure-matched) are labelled non-tradable and never used as gates

adoption_criteria: Family A as specified is still rejected
the synthetic example of S6 still passes only if it also passes V2-1..V2-3 with its declared inputs
every new check has a one-mutation failure test and a deterministic cross-process test
v1 and v2 results are reported side by side for every pre-registration
no threshold of v1 is edited; v2 is a new file and a new freeze record
not_in_scope: this proposal evaluates no strategy and registers no family
